capabilities: Move lists with children up, down and by indenting without breaking structure
Enhance Enter, Tab and Ctrl+A keys for outliner-style list behavior
Fold and unfold list branches with hotkeys
Drag and drop list items within the list
Improve list styling with vertical indentation lines
extras: Free for everyone. List styles and vertical indentation lines are only compatible with the built-in Obsidian theme. Multiple-line manipulation is listed as unsupported (yet).
problem: Obsidian's default list editing lacks outliner behaviors such as moving whole branches, outdenting empty items with Enter, and dragging list items.
